expectations.text: Advises against the reflexive smart/dumb/styles 3-way split
expectations.evidence: "don't do the classic smart/dumb/styles three-way split here" — opens by rejecting the split.

expectations.text: Recommends extracting a hook (abstraction) instead of splitting container/view files
expectations.evidence: "reach for an abstraction, not a file split... Extract it into a hook: const { cards, loading, error } = useSavedCards();"

expectations.text: Notes ~180 lines is acceptable as one cohesive file (raised size threshold)
expectations.evidence: "Keep it as one file for now. 180 lines of one coherent concern (a checkout form) is fine"; agents handle a few hundred lines before signal-to-noise degrades.

expectations.text: Grounds advice in AI agents' reluctance to read adjacent files / cross-file context cost
expectations.evidence: "AI agents... They're stubbornly reluctant to open adjacent files" and "doubled the cross-file lookups the agent skips."
